desc: Derive combinatorial reduction: total = sum_x x * sum_{k=0}^{N-1} e_k(weights of other numbers) k!(N-1-k)!.
Establish generating function G(t)=∏_l (1+10^l t)^{c_l}; for x of length L the multiplier comes from G/(1+10^L t).
Compute counts c_l and value sums sum_x_by_len for l=1..6 using ranges [10^{l-1}, min(N,10^l-1)].
Precompute factorials up to N and modular inverses 1..N modulo 998244353.
Build A(t)=∏(1+w_l t) and B(t)=∑ c_l w_l ∏_{m≠l}(1+w_m t) as small-degree polynomials (degree ≤6).
Compute g_0..g_N using recurrence (m+1)g_{m+1} = ∑ B_i g_{m-i} - ∑_{i≥1} A_i (m+1-i) g_{m+1-i} mod MOD, with g_0=1.
For each length L with c_L>0, divide G by (1+10^L t) via h_k = g_k - 10^L h_{k-1}, and compute M_L = ∑_{k=0}^{N-1} h_k k!(N-1-k)!.
Sum sum_x_by_len[L]*M_L mod MOD, handle N=1, read N from stdin, print answer.
